svg.text: IN: THE COPPER, ALL 97 LETTERS, THE 24 KNOWN PLACES IN ACCENT
a 4x4 Hill table with a shift: the copper in blocks of 4; each known letter is one equation for one row of the table
place 22 is the second letter of block 21-24, WFLR = [22, 5, 11, 17]: row 2 times those numbers, plus its shift, must give E = 4
ochre: the 7 known letters in a second position, 7 equations for row 2's five unknowns; the other rows get theirs the same way
settings by table size, every alignment of the blocks and four letter numberings
open: too few equations to decide
OUT: NO READING; NO HILL TABLE OF SIZE 2 TO 5 FITS
